messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Canary alert: increased inference errors on /v1/generate (5xx spike) — recent model promotion detected. auto-promote=false.
charlie_sre: I'm on it, joining channel. paging team, collect initial scope.
maya_prod: seeing garbled output for short completions, tokens split oddly, samples attached to the incident binder.
alice_eng: rolled out weight-bundle wb-accel-09 @ 4467889999 as part of blue-green promotion from canary.
daniel_ml: quick check — wb-accel-09 uses a rebuilt tokenizer binding; possible vocab mapping offset. looking now.
opsbot: runbook: disable auto-promote, flip feature flag `use-weights-v2` -> false. command: `rbctl flags set use-weights-v2 false --env prod`
charlie_sre: executed flag flip at 4467890035. throttling new sessions to stable weights alias `stable-v1`.
maya_prod: confirm traffic routed back to stable-v1; canary traffic drained. error rate dropping from 22% -> 3% on first histogram.
daniel_ml: dug into logs, token id histogram shows shift of +1 for common tokens starting at 4467889999. sample log: ```[2026-03-17T15:06:40Z] model=wb-accel-09 input_tokens=[101,102,103] output_token_ids=[405,406,...] expected=[101,102,103]``` suggests tokenizer binding mismatch.
opsbot: artifact metadata: s3://weights/prod/wb-accel-09/sha256:ab12cd34ef56 uploaded by deploy-bot at 4467889988. snapshot preserved.
charlie_sre: taking action: paused promotion, rolling cluster back to alias `stable-v1` across all zones. starting graceful eviction of canary pods.
emma_cs: FYI we have 1 enterprise customer on a support call reporting corrupted completions for ~6 minutes. they expect an incident summary and outreach.
charlie_sre: noted. emma_cs, please lead customer comms — we'll provide timeline and remediation notes.
alice_eng: root cause hypothesis: a tokenizer build step picked up a different vocab file during the weight bundle assembly pipeline; weights themselves likely fine but tokenizer mapping is incompatible.
daniel_ml: collecting diffs between vocab manifests now, will post PR id and exact failing entries.
maya_prod: current metrics: latency stable, error rate back to baseline, canary nodes at 0 traffic.
opsbot: initiated rollback job `rollback-promote-4467889999` at 4467890102, status: in_progress.
charlie_sre: rollback completed at 4467890128, all nodes on `stable-v1`. monitoring for 15m.
emma_cs: emailed affected customer with summary and mitigation steps, offered 1:1 debrief.
charlie_sre: tagging incident P1-short, will open postmortem with action items: block auto-promote for weight bundles until tokenizer parity check added; add rollback automation to run faster; better deploy gating tests for vocab hash equality.
daniel_ml: PR created: #8421 — add tokenizer parity check to build pipeline. scheduling hotfix deploy to canary after tests.
maya_prod: leaving channel to monitor dashboards. ping if regressions. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. duration ~2m. next steps assigned to alice_eng/daniel_ml/emma_cs.
charlie_sre: closing thread here, will keep incident record open for postmortem. thanks everyone for quick response.
